name: OpenKara
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils build-essential curl file libasound2-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libssl-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libxdo-dev patchelf wget
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" && mise trust && MISE_YES=1 mise install hk && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && ./scripts/setup.sh
